lists_every_proposal.reason: {"decision":"pass","trace":"GovernancePage always renders Proposals. When the wallet is disconnected or on the wrong chain, it passes account undefined, so the list still renders. useProposals runs a react-query load with a 12s refetch interval. loadProposals calls getContractEvents for ProposalCreated on the configured governor, from block 0 to the default latest block, in a single unpaginated scan. It builds one Proposal per log, using args.proposalId as the ID, and returns all of them reversed, with no filtering. Proposals maps every entry to a ProposalCard.
